svg.title: Check products, final status and provenance together
svg.desc: Schematic. A declared configuration requests selected products. Final status distinguishes completed, incomplete and failed attempts. Some complete earlier products may exist after a failure. Resolved configuration records effective choices, provenance records inputs and transformations, and status inventories products. One file alone does not prove run completion.

g.text: failed / missing · do not infer success
Keep the explanation with the data
Earlier complete products can survive a failure.
Schematic · file presence alone does not establish completion
